$comment: COS-PLUGIN-001 tool → app route map (P01, updated by P12 and P13). Verified against the real tools/list by src/__tests__/catalog-baseline.test.ts and src/__tests__/catalog-contract.test.ts (P13), which also check that each tool calls exactly its appRoutes; the sanitized tools/list snapshot is contracts/mcp-tools.json. tools.name: robynn_query_connected_app
tools.openDecision: D-A (Madhukar): requires tools:execute — default YES. The single flip point is requiredScopeAfterP07 in this entry (catalog-baseline.test.ts reads it). A downgrade to brand:read requires P07 first: until P07 removes the policy write the tool is not read-only, so rule 1 (readOnlyHint:false ⇒ tools:execute) keeps requiredScope at tools:execute. Before P07 the decision can be recorded by setting requiredScopeAfterP07 to brand:read alone. With P07 (flag flipped, currentHints/proposedHints = hintsAfterP07), set requiredScope to requiredScopeAfterP07 plus the matching P07 route scope; no tool code or description changes.
tools.conditional: † readOnlyHint stays false until P07 removes the getOrCreatePolicy write from the read path (connector-execution-service.ts:330 -> connector-policy-service.ts:27-33,61-99). Then flip CONNECTED_APP_READS_PERSIST_POLICY (src/tools/connectors.ts) and set currentHints/proposedHints to hintsAfterP07 and requiredScope to requiredScopeAfterP07 in the same change, then regenerate contracts/mcp-tools.json (the description changes). requiredScopeAfterP07 is the D-A flip point (default tools:execute).
tools.hintEvidence: curated read actions executed live against third-party apps via Composio/Arcade; the read path persists Robynn state: getOrCreatePolicy inserts a default connector_policies row or rewrites allowed_actions (re-adding admin-removed read actions) — plan §5 keeps read-only only if the backend prevents writes; connector_action_logs is an exempt audit write
tools.sideEffects: connector_policies insert/update (re-adds admin-removed read actions), connector_action_logs insert, connection health update
tools.externalAccess: Composio/Arcade -> HubSpot, GSC, GA, Google Ads, GitHub, ...
tools.objectOwnership: connection_id UUID, org-scoped strict
